column3: Close to the Hebrew; “you will loathe yourselves in your faces” is rendered “in your own sight.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I will cause the cities to be inhabited” is rendered “I will also enable you to dwell in the cities.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they have remained fortified” is rendered “are now fortified and inhabited.”
Close to the Hebrew; “like sheep of holy things” is rendered “Like a flock offered as holy sacrifices.”
